notes: PLEA (symbol PLEA, 18 decimals) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the OpenZeppelin v5 ERC20 implementation (src/PLEA.sol, contract PLEA). Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire supply of 1,000,000,000 PLEA (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, the constant INITIAL_SUPPLY) once to msg.sender, which under ProjectFactory.launchCustom is the factory; the factory then pays the whole supply out (swarm share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 87% seeded into the single-sided pool, the remaining requester share to economics.remainderTo). There is no mint function, no owner, no pause, blacklist, freeze, tax, burn-on-transfer or other transfer restriction: every transfer, approve and transferFrom moves exactly the stated amount, so the factory seed, distributor claims and PoolManager swaps arrive in full. The supply cannot grow after deployment. No application contracts are deployed with this launch (contracts is empty), there are no initialization calls, no proxies, no libraries to link, and the constructor makes no external calls. The pool pairs PLEA with IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only and the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (2,500 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply. Project website: imdacc.fun.
